source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)

text:
Landlord and Tenant Board
Application to Evict a Tenant for Non-payment of Rent and to Collect Rent the Tenant Owes
Form L1
Applicant (Landlord): Northview Property Management Inc.
Respondent (Tenant): Mariana Reyes
Rental unit: Unit 3, 128 Danforth Avenue, Toronto, Ontario M4K 1N1
The landlord gave the tenant a Form N4 notice with a termination date of 21/09/2026. The tenant did not pay the rent owing by the termination date.
The landlord asks the Board to: order the tenant to pay $3,700.00 in rent owing as of the date of this application; order the tenant to pay the filing fee of $186.00; terminate the tenancy and evict the tenant.
Tenant's Information: You will receive a Notice of Hearing. You may file a written response and any documents you want the Board to consider before the hearing.
